First, the key one is that real interest rates are trending up. Gold does poorly in that environment.

Second, the DXY has been rallying. That doesn’t always, but often does, hurt the gold price in dollar terms.

Third, there’s lots of leaked news about Trump re-escalating the Iran War. In previous escalations the price of gold has been hit. Which seems the opposite of what it should do as a safe haven investment but that’s been the recent history. The speculation for the negative price consequence is more potential energy infrastructure destruction will drive up energy prices that in turn will drive up interest rates - see item 1.
